name: Alith Anar
canonNotes: The Shadow King of Nagarythe, last heir of a line slain by Malekith's servants.
Has waged a merciless shadow war against the Druchii for millennia and will not rest until Malekith dies.
voiceNotes: Quiet, grim and vengeful; few words, all sharp.
Trusts almost no one; utter hatred for the Druchii.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
